platformHomeHTML:
What is VezaionGen VI?

VezaionGen VI is an integrated industrial web platform by NJB CodeMasters. It connects documented functions for factory operations, quality, maintenance, energy, robotics and logistics through shared data models and user interfaces.

Why Industry 6.0?

Production, transport, quality and energy are considered together rather than as isolated applications. Documented orchestration, data contracts and recovery paths provide the foundation. Connectivity and adaptive decisions are intended to support industrial resilience; this is not a performance promise.

Core Capabilities

Digital Twin

3D views, factory and zone geometry, and machine/asset models and states.

Robotics

Task assignment, failover and geometry checks. Hardware and safety integration require separate evidence.

Industrial Analytics

Analytics, anomaly and insight dashboards, and tool-life estimates. Prediction accuracy is not generally verified.

Autonomous Operations

Event-based orchestration, L0–L3 heuristics, simulation, recovery and human escalation. No promise of unattended autonomy.

Knowledge Systems

Operational rules, industrial data contracts and product, operator and transfer documentation. No independently trained knowledge model is claimed.

Quality Intelligence

Quality workflows, image/quality signals, detection and dashboards. A separately trained VezaionGen model is not evidenced.

Logistics Integration

Import and data checks, route enrichment, fleet operations, dispatch, GPS events and offline synchronization.

Energy & ESG

Energy and emissions data, carbon allocation and localized ESG reports. Regulatory compliance requires expert review.

These descriptions concern documented software functions. Maturity and measurable performance vary by area. Industrial use, autonomous decisions and hardware integration require separate validation.

Module Overview

Industrial Core

Factory operations, materials, tools, orders, maintenance and quality.

Digital Twin & Robotics

3D models, asset states, factory geometry and robot tasks.

Logistics & Transport

TMS import, data quality, routes, loading, fleet and driver interfaces.

ESG & Sustainability

Energy, emissions, carbon allocation and reports.

Autonomy & Self-Healing

Orchestration, heuristics, error/data-gap signals and recovery.

Integration Ecosystem

API contracts, data adapters, synchronization and external sources.

Module Overview

Pilot Program

The Pilot Program is a consultation and pilot option for pilot customers, industrial partners and manufacturing businesses. Suitable use cases, data access and validation steps are agreed together. Participation, scope and timing require an individual agreement.
